title: What Standard Evaluations Hide About Detectors of Hijacked LLM Agents: Rare Attacks, Unseen Tools and Benchmark Transfer
abstract: arXiv:2610.41803v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Detectors can flag hijacked large language model (LLM) agents from the traces of the tools they call. In the eleven evaluations we audited, attacks or anomalies make up 16% to 86% of the test samples, no evaluation varies that share, and six report no test on data from a second benchmark or source. We ask what such evaluations hide. On the AgentDrift and AgentDojo benchmarks we test trained detectors that read tool identities, behavior, call sequences, step embeddings or text, and a released LLM action monitor, AlignmentCheck, with thresholds fixed on training data or set by the monitor's released decision rule. First, at a 2% attack rate a detector with an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) of 0.879 reaches a precision of 0.076, and the mix of negatives alone moves that precision between 0.039 and 0.117. translated_title: 标准评估掩盖了被劫持LLM智能体检测器的哪些问题：罕见攻击、未见工具与基准迁移
translated_abstract: 检测器可以根据大语言模型（LLM）智能体调用工具的轨迹来识别被劫持的智能体。在我们审计的十一项评估中，攻击或异常样本占测试样本的16%到86%，没有任何一项评估改变这一比例，其中六项评估未报告在第二个基准或数据来源上进行测试。我们探究这样的评估究竟掩盖了什么。在AgentDrift和AgentDojo基准上，我们测试了读取工具身份、行为、调用序列、步骤嵌入或文本的训练型检测器，以及一个已发布的LLM动作监控器AlignmentCheck，其阈值在训练数据上固定，或按照该监控器发布的决策规则设定。首先，在2%的攻击率下，一个受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUROC）为0.879的检测器仅达到0.076的精确率，而仅负样本构成的差异就会使该精确率在0.039到0.117之间波动。其次，随着工具覆盖率（测试工具调用中训练阶段见过的工具所占比例）的下降，检测器……
tldr: 该研究通过对AgentDrift和AgentDojo基准上多种被劫持LLM智能体检测器的系统审计，揭示了标准评估的缺陷：在真实罕见的攻击率下，即使AUROC高达0.879的检测器精确率也仅0.076且受负样本构成强烈影响，同时未见过的工具和跨基准迁移会进一步削弱检测性能。
en_tdlr: This study audits standard evaluations of hijacked LLM agent detectors and reveals their hidden flaws: at realistic rare attack rates, even a detector with 0.879 AUROC achieves only 0.076 precision highly sensitive to negative-sample composition, while unseen tools and cross-benchmark transfer further degrade detection performance.
